chapter: Sonny South breakup and small bands
title: Kid Rena's small band at the Gypsy Tea Room
summary: After Sonny South he played piano in a four-piece band led by Kid Rena at the Gypsy Tea Room, nightly for two or three years, until large bands replaced them.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
